top_violation_types.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation no longer has  a fenced outdoor area.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's emergency preparedness plan was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Evidence shows that a caregiver used inappropriate discipline on their own child while in care.  Employee was terminated.
